description.en: Fully symmetric PI rules from the literature, reproduced for comparison: M. Diallo, Z. A. Worku: High-order symmetric positive interior quadrature rules on two and three dimensional domains. arXiv:2601.14488 (2026). Nodes and weights as published (15 digits); the build re-checks the moment equations.

Worku: High-order symmetric positive interior quadrature rules on two and three dimensional domains. arXiv:2601.14488 (2026). Knoten und Gewichte wie veröffentlicht (15 Stellen); der Build rechnet die Momentengleichungen nach.
